method: Same access budget (4 BP, 1 BP per once-only skill, forks only) for every tree. Raw flat total sums every static addition in a legal full allocation; row-weighted total multiplies each addition by the number of supported kit rows it reaches. Both are structural/arithmetic measures, not combat strength. Inherited kit strength (rank, row count, baseline values) is listed separately from the Bloodright additions.

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than Draft 5's ten and four. Damage reaches one row (Overloaded Impact, 40 EP, cooldown 6) and the only thing that can set up that strike is Chakra Overload's exposure, cast a round earlier: Overloaded Impact's own self buff is inert in its cast round and expires before its next cast. So Draft 5's Burst (Chakra Surcharge → Breaking Point) and Exposure routes are one lever and form one exposure → strike route (Cracked Vessel → Shattered Vessel); Chakra Surcharge and Breaking Point are removed. No distinct fourth Advanced Art exists: a separate strike route would need either an Increase Damage Taken setup (a twin of Cracked Vessel) or an Increase Damage Given one, which never reaches the strike, only repeats Amplification at a smaller size, and under Brimming Cup would push the kit's one Increase Damage Given row past +10% as Boundless Reservoir's fourth purchase; a separate exposure route is net-negative one-on-one (caster ×1.04 against target ×1.037) and twins Cracked Vessel; an amplify-and-suppress capstone only blends the two existing routes on the same rows. Sage's Rebuke is a universal node (in all 8 legal 4-BP builds) because Brimming Cup roots a single 3-node chain; the only way to break that is a Hidden-Art leaf under Brimming Cup, which would be filler, so Boundless Reservoir's fourth purchase is fixed.

entries.name: Ha Yanagi

emphasis.primary: Enemy debuff control: Decrease Damage Given (Wailing Bark, Petal Nightmare) and Increase Damage Taken (Blighted Tree)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on six rows; Decrease Damage Given (suppression), Increase Damage Taken (exposure) and Increase Damage Given (amplification) each own a route, and the fourth, Damage, reaches one meaningful row: Blighted Tree's formula 40 EP hit (60 AP, cooldown 7). Petal Nightmare's Damage row is static and deals its raw power, 40 HP before modifiers, so +N Damage there is +N HP. A Burst capstone at the most a single Normal row allows (+3, Blighted Tree 40 → 43 EP; +5 would cross into High) is ×1.075 on one hit every 7 rounds, the same gain Thousand-Leaf Dream's +10% gives that hit inside its window (×1.45 / 1.35 ≈ ×1.074) while the amplifier also lifts every other hit there, so Burst would be near-dominated; its percentage setup could only twin Rising Sap, Veil of Falling Petals or Blight Takes Root. The pre-batch Burst route (Hardened Heartwood → Nightmare in Bloom) is therefore not kept, and the Hardened Heartwood leaf is removed rather than kept only to avoid a universal node. Mourning Boughs is universal: it is in every legal 4-BP build, so the Amplifier build is fixed (06, 09, 10 + 01) and every build carries +2% Decrease Damage Given.

entries.name: Loup-Garou

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported rows, one per tag, on two casts (Damage, Increase Damage Given and Heal on Nature's Hunter; Increase Damage Taken on Life reaver); the Wolf Companion summon and Life reaver's absorb are unsupported. Three identities exist, one per phase of the hunt: the kill that feeds (Damage with the same cast's Heal), the mark (Increase Damage Taken) and the frenzy (Increase Damage Given). A fourth capstone would twin one of them on the same row or stand on Heal alone (10 HP per tick per point); that filler is declined. Scent of Blood is a universal node (in all 8 legal 4-BP builds) because Hunter's Moon roots a single 3-node chain, so every build carries +2% exposure and Frenzy's fourth purchase is fixed.

entries.name: Lycanthropy

emphasis.primary: Frenzy — Increase Damage Given on Frenzy Assault and Feral Wrath (two self rows that compound)
emphasis.secondary: Regeneration — Heal on Frenzy Assault (one static row)
emphasis.tertiary: Raw strike — a controlled +2 Damage payoff on Undying Hunger (Moonlit Fury 40 → 42, Feral Wrath 50 → 52, above the Nuke tier; director review)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Six nodes and two Advanced Arts rather than ten and four: the kit has three supported tags on five rows (Increase Damage Given x2, Damage x2, Heal x1), and only two Hidden Arts can differ in tag: Increase Damage Given (Blood on the Wind) and Heal (Lick the Wound); Damage is kept for the Advanced-Art payoff. The two identities are two 3-node chains: The Beast Within → Blood on the Wind → Red Moon Rising (frenzy) and Moonbound Vigor → Lick the Wound → Undying Hunger (regeneration with the tree's only flat Damage, a +2 payoff). Draft 4's seventh node, Gnashing Fangs, was a flat-Damage Hidden Art that put Feral Wrath at 52 as Red Moon Rising's fourth purchase; a third route would need a Hidden Art that repeats Increase Damage Given (a twin of Blood on the Wind, and under The Beast Within a fourth purchase that lifts Red Moon Rising past +8%), repeats Heal on the one Heal row, or carries flat Damage before the payoff, so none is added. Universal nodes accepted: with two 3-node chains every 4 BP build holds both Foundations, so the real choice is which chain to finish; the only other full build is the no-capstone hybrid (both Hidden Arts).

entries.name: Megumi Kijo

emphasis.tertiary: Damage — +2 on the two Genjutsu attacks (Phantom Realm Oblivion 40 → 42, Onibaba's Laughter 45 → 47), on Appetite of Oblivion only

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. Mountain Hag's Mercy forks onto Onibaba's Laughter (Heal, capped by a +2 Damage capstone) and onto Benevolence's field (Increase Heal); Hagmother's Welcome is a single chain because Decrease Damage Given is one row, and a second Welcome route would either repeat Suppression or take the Damage that now caps the Laughter lane. entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Increase Damage Given ×3, Damage ×2, Decrease Damage Taken ×1); a fourth Advanced Art would twin a capstone on the same rows or push the single Decrease Damage Taken row past +10%. Reading the Field therefore runs one guard chain and Drawn Steel is universal: it is in every legal 4-BP build, so the Fortress build is fixed and every build carries +2% Increase Damage Given. Every leaf that could avoid this is filler or illegal: a Damage leaf twins Single Stroke (the pre-batch Answering Cut, removed), an Increase Damage Given leaf only re-sells Drawn Steel as Fortress's fourth, and a Decrease Damage Taken leaf lifts the guard chain past +10%.

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Nine nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Increase Damage Taken x1, Increase Heal x1, Heal x1), and both healing rows sit on the one Verdant Bastion cast. A fourth Advanced Art would either split that single cast into a second healing capstone or repeat a Thorn and Rot route. Instead Sap of the Grove carries one leaf, Sudden Greening (+3% Heal: the bloodline's Burst Healing trait beside Deepening Roots' Sustained Healing, and Everbloom Sanctuary's natural fourth), so the grove root has its own 4 BP build and no node is universal.

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on four rows (Increase Damage Given on Reptile Chimera and Cool-Blooded Empowerment; Decrease Damage Taken on Reptile Chimera; Lifesteal on Cool-Blooded Empowerment), and each tag gets one route that maximizes it: self-amplification (IDG), fortress (DDT), pack sustain (Lifesteal); a fourth Advanced Art would repeat one of them. Chimeric Blood is a universal node (in all 8 legal 4 BP builds) because Blood of the Brood's subtree is one 3-node chain. A 1 BP leaf under Blood of the Brood would need to beat Chimeric Blood (+2% IDG, +2% DDT) as Pack sustain's fourth: Lifesteal is already at the +5% ceiling, Decrease Damage Taken +3% twins Hardened Scales, and Increase Damage Given +3% lets 06, leaf, 01, 02 reach +7% IDG, the Jaws route without its capstone. A mirrored layout only moves the universal node to the other root.

emphasis.secondary: Tank — Decrease Damage Taken (Timelapse self row) and Heal (Cellular Regeneration)

emphasis.tertiary: Decrease Damage Taken — Sea King's Armor's self reduction (one row, +10% route)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as in the pre-batch tree. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Increase Damage Taken x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1), one route each: Scales of the Deep forks into Burst (Grip of the Riptide → Weight of the Trench) and Fortress (Deepwater Carapace → Hull of the Leviathan); Salt in the Wound → Dragged Under → Wrath of the Sea-King is the single exposure chain. A fourth route needs a fourth tag (absorb and shield are not potency targets). Universal node accepted: Scales of the Deep is in all 8 legal full builds, so Exposure's fourth purchase is always its +2% Decrease Damage Taken. A 1 BP leaf under Salt in the Wound would end that, but each option fails: Increase Damage Taken twins Dragged Under and hands Exposure's fourth its own tag again (back toward the +10% the route was cut from), Damage puts flat Damage on the exposure capstone's build, and Decrease Damage Taken is an off-axis twin of Scales of the Deep (or dominates or is dominated by it).

entries.name: Shadow Weaver

emphasis.primary: Burst from Loom of Dusk: Barbed Thread sets up the three stacking self buffs (Increase Damage Given) and Night Unraveled pays off with a controlled +2 Damage on four 40 EP Shadow attacks
emphasis.secondary: Fortress on Shadow Shell's Decrease Damage Taken (+10%) and Suppression on Shadow Severance's Decrease Damage Given (+10%)
emphasis.tertiary: Increase Damage Given outside Burst: a +2% rider on the Fortress and the Umbral Whetstone lean (+4% together)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Nine nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as before the batch. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Decrease Damage Given x1, Decrease Damage Taken x1). Burst takes Damage with Increase Damage Given as its setup, Suppression takes Decrease Damage Given and Fortress takes Decrease Damage Taken. A fourth capstone could only be a second Increase Damage Given route: it would read as Burst without the Damage, and on three compounding self buffs it could not exceed Burst's +5% without becoming the tree's strongest offensive stack. Umbral Whetstone is a Hidden-Art leaf so that the defensive root completes a full build (06, 07, 08, 09) without Loom of Dusk; it shares Barbed Thread's tag and rows (see design_review.concerns).

director_exceptions.reason: Director-approved Shakunetsu Sakura structure (RUL-2026-10-04-002): both Ember Dragon's Roots routes lean on the single Sakura Dragon Tree self buff, and +13% arises only from a capstone plus the sibling Hidden Art (01+02+03+07 or 01+07+08+02).

entries.name: Shinrai Ou

emphasis.primary: Damage (Burst: Vajra Tempering charges the Storm Cloak and Raijin self buffs, then Thunder King's Wrath pays off with +2 Damage on all four Storm attacks)
emphasis.secondary: Increase Damage Taken (Izanagi's Hammer area exposure, +10% route) and Reflect (Indra's Storm Cloak retaliation, +10% route)
emphasis.tertiary: Increase Damage Given (Mandate of Thunder and the Burst setup; three compounding rows held at +4%)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, the same shape as before the batch. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Increase Damage Taken x1, Reflect x1), and each Advanced Art owns one idea: burst (self-charge setup into +2 Damage), exposure (Hammer) and retaliation (the Cloak's Reflect). A fourth capstone would twin one of them: a pure Increase Damage Given route would reuse Vajra Tempering's three compounding rows, whose compounding holds them to about +5%, so it would be Burst without its payoff; a second exposure or Reflect route would split a single row; a second Damage route would repeat the 50 → 52 payoff. Mandate of Thunder forks into Burst and Exposure and Raiment of Storms carries the single Reflect chain, so Mandate of Thunder is a universal node (in all 8 legal full builds): Raiment's 3-BP chain needs a fourth purchase and Mandate is the only prerequisite-closed one. A Hidden Art leaf under Raiment would be filler: a Reflect leaf lifts Reflect past +10%, an Increase Damage Given leaf is a one-point sliver or, with Vajra Tempering, pushes the three compounding rows past +5%, an exposure leaf twins Lightning Rod, and a Damage leaf puts flat Damage on a Hidden Art. Burst and Exposure each keep two fourth-purchase choices; Retaliation has one.

entries.name: Shinseina Ki

emphasis.secondary: Exposure — Guardian's Grove's area Increase Damage Taken, which multiplies every attacker's hits on the caught enemies (one row, +10% route)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as before the 2026-10-04 batch. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Damage x3, Increase Damage Given x2 on one cast, Increase Damage Taken x1), so it holds exactly three identities: self amplification (Hallowed Seed → Rooted in Wisdom → Heartwood Awakened), exposure (Grasping Roots → Rootbound Prey → Judgement of the Grove) and burst (Grasping Roots → Fangs of Heartwood → The Forest Devours). A fourth capstone could only repeat one of those tags on the same rows. Universal node accepted: Grasping Roots is in all 8 legal full builds, because Heartwood Awakened's only prerequisite-closed fourth purchase is the other Foundation. A second Hidden Art under Hallowed Seed would be filler: an Increase Damage Given leaf twins Rooted in Wisdom on the same two rows and stacks with Heartwood Awakened, an Increase Damage Taken leaf twins Rootbound Prey, and a Damage leaf twins Fangs of Heartwood and becomes Heartwood Awakened's best fourth, the raw Damage on the compounding window that this layout keeps apart.

emphasis.tertiary: No riders: each capstone carries one effect. The kit has no Afterburn, Heal, Lifesteal or Reflect rows

emphasis.primary: Offense (Eye of Iron): burst that hones the stances' Increase Damage Given and pays off with +2 Damage on the seven Metal strikes, or branding the enemy with Crimson Thrust's Afterburn and exposure
emphasis.secondary: Defense (Tempered Stance): a fortress on the three Decrease Damage Taken rows, or retaliation through Harmonious Slash's Reflect with suppression
emphasis.tertiary: Flat Damage only as One Cut Decides' controlled +2 payoff (40 → 42, 45 → 47, Phantom Slash 50 → 52)

emphasis.primary: Rush offense from Rising Steam: Drowning Strike's spiral exposure into +2 Damage on the three Boil attacks (Drowning Strike 40, Surfing Strike 45, Scorch Break 40 EP), or Afterburn branded on the Liquid Ember Shell's target
emphasis.secondary: Outlasting the exchange from Vapor Shroud: Lifesteal with an Azure Dragon Palm Heal rider, or Reflect behind Decrease Damage Taken
emphasis.tertiary: Foundation glue: Increase Damage Given and Increase Damage Taken on Rising Steam, Decrease Damage Taken on Vapor Shroud

entries.name: Voltara Divine

emphasis.primary: Lightning amplification — Increase Damage Given (Luminous Illusion Bind, Ethereal Dragon's Whispers; two self rows)
emphasis.secondary: Lightning burst — Damage (Bind 40, Whispers 50 EP): a controlled +2 payoff on each strike's own cast, Whispers 50 → 52 above the Nuke tier
emphasis.tertiary: Blitz guard — Decrease Damage Taken (Voltara Blitz; one self row, the fortress route)

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Increase Damage Given x2, Damage x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1; Blitz's move and pierce and Bind's stun are unsupported). A fourth Advanced Art would twin a capstone on the same rows or push Blitz's single Decrease Damage Taken row past +10%. Halo of Static therefore runs one chain (Aegis of Living Light → Unassailable Radiance) and Anointed by Lightning is universal: it is in every legal 4 BP build, so the Fortress build is fixed (06, 07, 08 + 01). The pre-batch Heaven's Retort leaf that avoided this is not restored: it was +2 Damage on a Hidden Art kept only so no node was universal, and any other second leaf under Halo of Static could only repeat Decrease Damage Taken on Blitz's row or Increase Damage Given from the other root.

entries.name: Yaketsuku Netsu

emphasis.primary: Increase Damage Given — Forgotten Ember Blade's self heat window (the Sustained DPS identity; the bloodline passive is also a Bukijutsu Increase Damage Given)
emphasis.secondary: Increase Damage Taken — Forbidden Chakra Fury's exposure, which every attacker's non-pierce hits use
emphasis.tertiary: Damage — a controlled +2 on both attacks (40 → 42 EP): a +1 commit on Searing Edge and a +1 payoff on Blade That Never Cools

entries.narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four: the kit has three supported tags on four rows (Damage on both attacks, one self Increase Damage Given row on Forgotten Ember Blade, one enemy Increase Damage Taken row on Forbidden Chakra Fury); Chakra Shield's absorb and shield are not potency targets, so no sustain or defensive identity exists for a fourth route. Universal opener accepted: Heat in the Steel is in all 8 legal full builds because Blistered Guard has one child. Every second leaf under Blistered Guard would twin an existing node on the same row: an Increase Damage Given leaf twins Heat in the Steel (and only replaces it as the Exposure route's fourth), a Damage leaf twins Searing Edge, and an Increase Damage Taken leaf twins Seams Laid Bare and lifts the exposure maximum above +10%.
